demand.name: Potrero southbound hospital approach
demand.selection_rule: Arithmetic midpoint of the published directional range; fixed before any Phase 13c score
demand.source_title: Potrero Corridor Complete Streets Project, Community Meeting #2, 30 July 2013

incident.rationale: First directed road in expected_road_edges with a legal detour from its from-node to the sink avoiding that road. A fallen tree blocks every lane. Start 240 s; 900 s clearance is hypothetical, not a cited SF clearance estimate. Photo: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fallen_tree_blocking_A36_-_geograph.org.uk_-_3794373.jpg (David Martin, CC BY-SA 2.0). The literal Phase 15 reachability rule selects edge 12 (54->175); edge 14 was the Phase 13f result under its stricter avoided-exit-node rule. The footprint is centered by rule before scoring.
